summary.text: This resolution condemns Hezbollah’s repeated violations of ceasefire agreements and calls on the Lebanese government to ensure Hezbollah immediately ceases all attacks against Israel and disarms in the South Litani Sector, in accordance with ceasefire terms.

title: Condemning Lebanese Hezbollah's repeated violations of ceasefire agreements and calling for the Lebanese Government to ensure Lebanese Hezbollah immediately ceases all attacks and disarms, in accordance with the ceasefire.
